items.title: Repository includes a clear open-source license
items.description: Add a LICENSE file in the repository root, such as MIT, Apache-2.0, GPL-3.0, or another OSI-approved license.

items.title: Repository includes a Code of Conduct
items.description: Add CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md at the top level and make it easy for contributors to find.

items.title: README explains the project clearly
items.description: Explain what the software does, who it helps, how to use it, and how people can contribute.

items.title: Contributing guide is available
items.description: Add beginner-friendly steps for reporting issues, proposing changes, and submitting pull requests.

items.title: Changelog tracks important updates
items.description: Document notable changes so users and contributors can follow the project’s release history.

items.title: Roadmap shows planned improvements
items.description: Publish upcoming priorities so contributors can understand the direction of the project.

items.title: Issue tracker is linked and welcoming
items.description: Make it easy for users to report bugs, suggest features, and identify beginner-friendly work.

items.title: Security policy explains responsible reporting
items.description: Document supported versions and provide a private way to report sensitive security concerns.

items.title: Decision-making and maintainer roles are documented
items.description: Explain how decisions are made, who maintains the software, and how responsibilities may grow.

items.title: Project site supports the software community
items.description: Provide documentation, release history, roadmap details, and contributor links directly related to the software.
